definitions.explanation: The native Japanese counter for seven objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦たまご→たまご：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{七|なな}つ⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.english: There are seven in the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{七|なな}つ⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{七|なな}つ⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: I received seven apples, so I shared them with my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七|なな}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There are seven temples in this town, and you can walk to all of them.

notes:
{七|なな}つ is the native Japanese counter for seven objects. It's part of the ⟦ひとつ→ひとつ：02948_hitotsu⟧ counting system used for general objects.

THE NATIVE COUNTING SYSTEM (1-10):
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→ひとつ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one
- ⟦{二|ふた}つ→ふたつ：02953_futatsu⟧: two
- ⟦{三|みっ}つ→みっつ：02970_mittsu⟧: three
- ⟦{四|よっ}つ→よっつ：03039_yottsu⟧: four
- ⟦{五|いつ}つ→いつつ：02892_itsutsu⟧: five
- ⟦{六|むっ}つ→むっつ：02974_muttsu⟧: six
- {七|なな}つ: seven
- ⟦{八|やっ}つ→やっつ：02979_yattsu⟧: eight
- ⟦{九|ここの}つ→ここのつ：02902_kokonotsu⟧: nine
- ⟦{十|とお}→十：28376_too⟧: ten (no つ)

USAGE:
- General objects without specific counters
- Age of children (under 10): {七|なな}つ = 7 years old
- Informal counting

CONTRAST WITH SINO-JAPANESE:
- {七|なな}つ (native): used alone or for general objects
- {七|しち} (Sino-Japanese): used with specific counters (⟦{七人|しちにん}→七人：30350_shichinin⟧, ⟦{七個|ななこ}→七個：30373_nanako⟧)

NOTE ON {七|なな}:
The reading なな is preferred over しち in many cases to avoid confusion with ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) and ⟦{四|し}→四：00767_yon⟧ (four).
